title: Memory Entry v2
description: Schema for a single memory entry (v2: two-layer scope + three-tier visibility, back-compat with v1 fields).

scope.description: Layer: global = cross-project shared store; workspace = current project/task store.

visibility.description: Shared switch: private = owner only; shared = same workspace/collaborators; global = all agents.

owner_agent.description: Agent ID that created the memory (from --agent-id or MEMORY_AGENT_ID env).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the memory was created.

source_conversation_id.description: Conversation ID from which the memory was extracted. Null if manually created.

title.description: Short title summarizing the memory (< 50 chars recommended).

summary.description: Concise summary of the memory content (< 200 chars recommended).

tags.description: List of lowercase, hyphenated tags for categorization and search.

priority.description: Discrete priority tier. P1 = critical decisions/debug/user-explicit; P3 = routine state.

access_count.description: Number of times this memory has been recalled.

last_accessed.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last recall. Null if never accessed.

ttl_days.description: Time-to-live in days. Null means never expires.

decay_score.description: Ebbinghaus-style decayed importance used for archive decisions.

status.description: Lifecycle status. archived entries are moved to archive/ directory.

embedding.description: Optional semantic vector. Reserved for future use; keyword search works without it.

embedding_model.description: Name of the embedding model that produced the vector.
